tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search Korean Today articles by keyword, with optional category and date range. Returns title, date, short excerpt and source url. Matches title and body text, so relevance varies.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one article by id as plain text, truncated (default 3000 chars, max 8000) with a link to read the full article at the source.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: List the most recent Korean Today articles, optionally within one category.

tools.name: list_news_categories
tools.description: List Korean Today categories (id, name, article count, parent) ordered by count. Also reports which category ids are treated as the site's own promotional ones.
